card.name: The word average after "on"
card.fires_on: The word "average" right after "on" or "on the", in the phrase "on average". It usually comes before a comma and a statement about typical results.

modes.label: Clinical results
modes.description: "On average" introduces a typical change in lab values or trial outcomes.
modes.example: analyses from clinical studies, for adults with schizophrenia who remained on treatment with iloperidone 10-16 mg/day glucose increased, on<< average>>, from baseline by 1.8

modes.label: General statistics
modes.description: "On (the) average" introduces a typical amount in non-medical web text.
